ORDINANCE IX OF 2003
ORDINANCE IX OF
2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
(THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier
Province Finance
Art, 1996
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 20th August , 2003]
No. LEGIS.1(14)/73/4900, dated
20-8-2003. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Finance (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 11 of N.-W.F.P. Act No. I of 1996

ORDINANCE IX OF 2003
ORDINANCE IX OF
2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
(THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier
Province Finance
Art, 1996
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 20th August , 2003]
No. LEGIS.1(14)/73/4900, dated
20-8-2003. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 11 of
N.-W.F.P. Act No. I of 1996.--In the North-West Frontier Province Finance
Act, 1996 (N.-W.F.P. Act No. I of 1996), in section 11, for subsection(1), the
following subsections shall be substituted, namely:--
"11. Tobacco development
cess.--(1) There shall be levied and collected development cess on tobacco
at the following rates, naively:
(a) for virginia (flue-cured, burley Rs.2.00 per kilogram.
and
dark-air-cured);
(b) for white patta/rustica tobacco Re. 1.00 per kilogram.
including
khaka, kara and roth
made
of mainstalk (dandi) and
stem
of tobacco; and
(c) for snuff/niswar. Re.0.70
per kilogram.
(1a) The cess shall be recovered
from---
(a) tobacco manufacturing
factories on the basis of quota fixed for the factory concerned by the Pakistan
Tobacco Board; and
(b) persons dealing in tobacco
business, who are transporting tobacco outside the zone of its production:
Provided that tobacco
manufacturing factories shall not be liable to pay the cess on tobacco on which
cess has already been paid under clause (b):
Provided further that no cess
shall be charged on the tobacco being transported, for which the cess has
already been paid under clause (a).
Explanation:--
For the purpose of this section,--
(i) there shall be the following
Zones, namely:
Zone-I Districts of Charsadda,
Swabi, Mardan, Nowshera, Tehsil Dargai and lower areas of District Buner
adjoining District Swabi;
Zone-II. District Mansehra;
Zone-III. Malakand Division; and
such other Zones
as Government, may from time to time, by notification in the official Gazette,
specify;
(ii) the word
'person' used in clause (b) of subsection (la) shall also include tobacco
manufacturing factories, if these factories are transporting' tobacco outside
the zone in addition to the quota allocated to them by the Pakistan Tobacco
Board.".
